blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Feedforward reconstruction of dynamic driving scenes requires integrating observations across multiple views and time steps into a coherent 3D representation. PointForward established state-of-the-art feedforward driving reconstruction by lifting image observations into sparse 3D queries, demonstrating the effectiveness of point-aligned scene representations. However, these queries are largely processed independently, limiting information exchange across space and time, while direct global attention among tens of thousands of point queries is computationally prohibitive. In this work, we present \textbf{PointForward V2}, which advances point-aligned representation to point-aligned interaction. Our key idea is to mediate query interaction through compact, scene-structured registers. For the static background, frame-wise Static Scene Registers compress point information, communicate across frames, and propagate the aggregated context back to the queries. For each dynamic instance, queries from different frames are aligned in an object-centric canonical space and interact through instance-specific Dynamic Instance Registers. We further employ 4D positional encoding that combines aligned spatial coordinates with original timestamps, enabling spatially aligned yet temporally distinguishable interactions. In this way, PointForward V2 enables scalable spatio-temporal reasoning directly among lifted 3D queries without dense global attention. Experiments on Waymo, nuScenes, and Argoverse 2 demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across large-scale driving benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 向后重建动态驱动场景,需要将多种观点和时间步骤的观察纳入连贯的三维代表。 PointForward通过将图像观测提升到稀疏的3D查询中,以显示点对齐场景表现效果的方式,建立了先进的驱动重建的源头. 然而,这些查询基本上是独立处理的,限制了跨时空的信息交流,而数以万计的点查询之间的直接全球关注在计算上是令人无法接受的。 在这项工作中,我们提出\ textbf{PointForward V2},它将点对齐的表示推进到点对齐的交互. 我们的关键想法是通过紧凑的场景结构登记册来调解查询互动。 对于静态背景,采用帧式的静态场景登记册压缩点信息,跨帧通信,并将汇总上下文传播回查询中. 对于每个动态实例,来自不同框架的查询在一个以物体为中心的条形空间中对齐,并通过实例特定的动态实例登记册进行互动。 我们进一步采用4D定位编码,将对齐的空间坐标与原来的时间戳结合起来,使空间对齐但可分时的相互作用成为可能。 这样,PointForward V2就可以在不引起全球关注的情况下,在解除的3D查询中直接进行可伸缩的时空推理. 有关Waymo,nuScens,Argoverse 2的实验展示了跨越大规模驾驶基准的先进性能.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Accurately reconstructing dynamic driving scenes is fundamental to autonomous driving and supports applications such as novel-view synthesis, simulation, and closed-loop evaluation. Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have enabled high-fidelity reconstruction, and subsequent methods extend them to large-scale dynamic driving environments through scene decomposition, object-centric modeling, and spatio-temporal representations [ 19 , 16 , 34 , 35 , 7 ] . However, these approaches typically rely on costly per-scene optimization. Recent feedforward methods instead learn cross-scene priors and reconstruct unseen scenes in a single forward pass [ 2 , 4 , 36 , 3 ] . PointForward [ 8 ] further departs from the prevailing pixel-aligned paradigm by lifting image observations into sparse 3D queries and constructing point-aligned scene representations. This formulation achieves state-of-the-art feedforward reconstruction across driving benchmarks, validating point alignment as an effective representation for dynamic driving scenes. Yet the resulting point queries are still processed largely independently: point alignment determines where information is represented, but does not, by itself, enable information exchange between points.
blocks.zh: 准确重建动态驱动场景对自主驾驶至关重要,支持小说-视觉合成,模拟,闭路评价等应用. 神经辐射场(NERFs)和3D高斯电镀(3DGS)使得高真性重建成为可能,随后的方法通过场景分解,以物体为中心的模型,以及斯皮提奥时空的表示[19,16,34,35,7],将其扩展到了大规模的动态驱动环境. 然而,这些办法通常依靠成本高昂的人均景色优化。 近代的向导方法反而学习了跨场面的前传,并在一次前传[2,4,36,3]中重建了看不见的场景. PointForward [8]进一步偏离了流行的像素对齐范式,将图像观测提升到稀少的3D查询中,构建点对齐的场景表现. 这一提法实现了跨越驱动基准的最先进的推进重建,验证了点对齐,作为动态驱动场景的有效体现。 然而,由此产生的点问询在很大程度上仍然独立处理:点对接决定了信息在哪些地方出现,但单靠点与点之间不能进行信息交流。

blocks.en: In PointForward [ 8 ] , each query gathers multi-view evidence by projecting its 3D location back to the input images, sampling the corresponding image features, and aggregating them through spatio-temporal fusion. Consequently, spatially or temporally related queries cannot directly exchange complementary geometric and appearance cues. A natural solution is global self-attention [ 31 , 9 ] over the point queries, but its quadratic complexity becomes prohibitive for the tens of thousands of queries required to represent a driving scene. Prior work has explored compact intermediate representations to enable scalable global communication [ 17 , 13 , 12 , 10 , 20 , 32 ] . However, directly applying a proxy-token mechanism overlooks the compositional structure of driving scenes, where the static background is shared across frames. Moreover, dynamic instances form independent object-centric components. This raises a question: how can point-aligned queries interact efficiently while respecting the structure of dynamic driving scenes?
blocks.zh: 在PointForward [8]中,每个查询通过将它的3D位置投射回输入图像,对相应的图像特征进行取样,并通过spatio-temporal聚变来汇总来收集多视图证据. 因此,与空间或时间有关的查询不能直接交换辅助几何和外观提示。 一个自然的解决方案是全球自觉性[31,9]在点的询问上,但其四面体的复杂性对代表驱动场景所需的数万次询问变得令人望而却步. 先前的工作探索了紧凑的中间表述,以便能够进行可扩展的全球交流[17、13、12、10、20、32]。 然而,直接应用代理键机制忽略了驱动场景的构成结构,其中静态背景是跨帧共享的. 此外,动态实例构成独立的以对象为中心的组件. 这提出了一个问题:如何在尊重动态驱动场景结构的同时,使点对齐的询问有效地相互作用?

blocks.en: Figure 1 : From point-aligned representation to interaction. While PointForward processes 3D queries independently, PointForward V2 enables scene-structured interaction: static queries communicate across frames, while dynamic queries interact within each instance.
blocks.zh: 图1:从点对齐的表述到互动. PointForward独立处理3D查询的同时,PointForward V2可以实现场景结构的交互:静态查询可以跨帧交流,而动态查询则在每个实例内交互.

blocks.en: In this work, we present PointForward V2 , a feedforward driving reconstruction framework that advances point-aligned representation to point-aligned interaction. Instead of performing attention directly among point queries, we introduce compact, scene-structured registers as bridges. For the static background, we perform inter-frame scene interaction through Static Scene Registers. Point queries first compress information into the corresponding registers; registers from different frames then exchange information through self-attention; and the aggregated context is propagated back to the point queries. This compress–communicate–broadcast process enables scene-wide information exchange while shifting the expensive interaction from point space to a substantially smaller register space.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出 " 前进点V2 " ,这是一个推动重建的支线框架,将 " 点对称 " 表述推向 " 点对称 " 互动。 我们不直接注意点查询,而是采用紧凑的、场景结构化的登记册作为桥梁。 对于静态背景,我们通过静态场景记录进行场景间互动. 点查询首先将信息压缩到相应的登记册中;从不同框架登记然后通过自我观察交换信息;将汇总上下文传播到点查询。 这种压缩-通信-广播程序使得整个场景的信息交流成为可能,同时将昂贵的互动从点空间转移到大大缩小的注册空间。

blocks.en: Dynamic instances require a different interaction structure. Following PointForward and related dynamic reconstruction methods [ 37 , 34 , 7 , 8 ] , we align each moving instance’s observations in an object-centric canonical space and assign each instance its own Dynamic Instance Registers. This enables intra-instance interaction among canonicalized observations while keeping different instances independent. The resulting topology follows the composition of driving scenes: static observations interact across frames, whereas dynamic observations interact within their respective canonical spaces. We further employ 4D rotary positional encoding [ 25 ] using aligned spatial coordinates and original timestamps, preserving temporal provenance during register-mediated interaction.
blocks.zh: 动态实例需要不同的交互结构. 按照“点前”和相关的动态重建方法[37、34、7、8],我们将每个移动实例的观测结果放在以物体为中心的线条空间,并指定每个实例自己的动态实例登记册。 这样,在保持不同实例独立性的同时,能够使各种犬类观察之间的内在互动。 由此产生的地形学沿袭了驱动场景的构成:静态观测在框架之间相互作用,而动态观测则在各自的峡谷空间内相互作用. 我们进一步采用4D旋转位置编码[25],使用对齐的空间坐标和原时间戳,在寄存器和调节器的相互作用中保留时间来源。

blocks.en: We evaluate PointForward V2 on three autonomous-driving benchmarks. On Waymo [ 26 ] , it improves full-image PSNR over PointForward from 28.48 to 29.88 and reduces dynamic-region D-RMSE from 6.07 to 3.99. The improvements remain consistent on nuScenes [ 1 ] and Argoverse 2 [ 33 ] under both zero-shot and fine-tuning settings. Comprehensive ablations further validate the effectiveness of point interaction and scene-structured registers.
blocks.zh: 我们在三个自主驾驶基准上评估“前进点”V2。 在Waymo[26]上,它改进了PSNR在PointForward上的全图像从28.48到29.88,并将动态区域D-RMSE从6.07减少到3.99. 在零镜头和微调设置下,nuScenes [1] 和Argoverse 2 [33]的改进仍然一致. 综合模拟进一步验证点间互动和场景结构登记册的有效性。

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献可归纳如下:

blocks.en: • We propose PointForward V2 , advancing feedforward driving reconstruction from point-aligned representation to point-aligned interaction and enabling efficient spatio-temporal information exchange among dense 3D queries. • We introduce scene-structured register interaction, where Static Scene Registers enable inter-frame scene interaction for the static background. Moreover, Dynamic Instance Registers enable intra-instance interaction among canonicalized observations of each moving instance. • Extensive experiments on Waymo, nuScenes, and Argoverse 2 show consistent improvements over previous feedforward reconstruction methods, with comprehensive ablations validating the proposed interaction framework.

blocks.en: Feedforward Driving Scene Reconstruction. Feedforward reconstruction methods learn cross-scene priors to predict explicit 3D representations directly without per-scene optimization. Early approaches such as pixelSplat and MVSplat [ 2 , 4 ] predict pixel-aligned 3D Gaussians from posed images, while later methods extend this paradigm to uncalibrated or pose-free inputs [ 24 , 6 , 14 ] . Recent works further address dynamic driving scenes. DrivingForward [ 29 ] targets real-time reconstruction from surround-view inputs, while STORM [ 36 ] models scene dynamics through Gaussian motion. DGGT [ 3 ] jointly estimates camera parameters, Gaussian representations, and scene dynamics for pose-free 4D reconstruction, while ReconDrive [ 39 ] leverages geometric foundation models for static–dynamic reconstruction. Instant NuRec [ 11 ] reconstructs driving logs into static and dynamic Gaussian representations in a single forward pass. PointForward [ 8 ] introduces sparse 3D queries for point-aligned feedforward driving reconstruction; PointForward V2 builds on this representation and focuses on efficient interaction.
blocks.zh: FeedForward 驱动场景重建。 FeedForward重建方法学习跨场面前传,可以直接预测清晰的3D表示,而无需每个场面优化. 早期的方法如像素Splate和MVSplate[2,4]从摆放的图像中预测像素对齐的3D高斯人,而后来的方法将这个范式扩展到未校准或无姿势的输入[24,6,14]. 最近的工作进一步涉及动态驱动场景. DriverForward [29] 从环景输入中瞄准实时重建,而STORM [36] 模型场景动态通过高斯运动. DGGT [3] 联合估算相机参数,高斯表示,和场景动态,用于无假4D重建,而ReconDrive [39] 则为静态-动力重建利用几何基础模型. Instant NuRec [11] 将驱动日志重建成静态和动态的高斯表达方式,在一个单一的前传中. PointForward [8] 引入了对点对齐的向导驱动重建的稀少的3D查询; PointForward V2基于这种表示并专注于高效的交互.

blocks.en: Structured Dynamic Scene Representation. Dynamic driving scenes naturally consist of a largely static background and multiple moving instances. Neural Scene Graphs [ 21 ] , UniSim [ 37 ] , and SUDS [ 30 ] exploit explicit scene structure and static–dynamic decomposition for dynamic-scene modeling, while EmerNeRF [ 35 ] models scene dynamics with static and dynamic neural fields and scene flow. Recent Gaussian-based methods, including Street Gaussians [ 34 ] , DeSiRe-GS [ 22 ] , and OmniRe [ 7 ] , further represent object-centric dynamics with explicit Gaussians. PointForward [ 8 ] organizes dynamic instances in object-centric canonical coordinates while maintaining the static background in a shared world coordinate system. PointForward V2 further uses this compositional structure to define the interaction scope: static observations interact across frames, whereas dynamic observations interact only within their corresponding instances.
blocks.zh: 结构化动态场景代表性. 动态驱动场景自然包含一个基本静止的背景和多个移动实例. 神经场景图[21],UniSim [37],和SUDS [30] 利用明显的场景结构和静态-动力分解来进行动态场景建模,而EmerNERF [35] 模型场景动态具有静态和动态神经场和场景流. 最近基于高斯的方法,包括 Street Gaussians [34], DeSiRe-GS [22],和Omnire [7],进一步代表了以对象为中心的动态,带有明显的高斯人. PointForward [8] 在以物体为中心的舟形坐标中组织动态实例,同时在共享的世界坐标系统中保持静态背景. PointForward V2进一步使用这种组成结构来定义相互作用的范围:静态观测在框架之间相互作用,而动态观测仅在它们相应的实例中相互作用.

blocks.en: Efficient Global Interaction. Global self-attention enables long-range information exchange but scales quadratically. Prior work reduces this cost using compact intermediate representations, including inducing points in Set Transformer [ 17 ] , latent arrays in Perceiver [ 13 ] and Perceiver IO [ 12 ] , and adaptive or proxy tokens in TokenLearner [ 23 ] and Agent Attention [ 10 ] . Similar ideas have also been explored in geometric reasoning: CoTracker [ 15 ] uses token proxies for large sets of point tracks, while DELTA [ 20 ] adopts efficient global–local attention for long-range 3D tracking. Most closely related, VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 32 ] restricts inter-frame communication to compact register tokens. PointForward V2 follows this compact-mediated interaction principle, but organizes the communication bottlenecks according to driving-scene composition: Static Scene Registers enable inter-frame interaction, while Dynamic Instance Registers restrict interaction to each canonicalized moving instance.
blocks.zh: 高效的全球互动。 全球自觉可以进行远距离信息交流,但规模是四倍的。 以前的工作利用紧凑的中间表示法,包括Set Transformer [17]中的诱导点,Perceiver [13]和Perceiver IO [12]中的潜在数组,以及TokenLearner [23]和Agent Region [10]中的适应或代用符号,来降低这一成本. 在几何推理中也探索了类似的想法:CoTracker [15]对大套点轨使用符号代号,而DELTA [20]则采用高效的全球-局部关注来进行远程3D跟踪. 最密切关联的, VGGT - ship – ship \Omega [32] 将帧间通信限制到紧凑的注册符. PointForward V2遵循这种紧凑的介质相互作用原则,但根据驱动-场景组成来组织通信瓶颈: 静态场景登记册可以实现帧间互动,而动态实例登记册则将互动限制在每一个犬类化的移动实例.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Given T T multi-view context images, PointForward V2 reconstructs the dynamic scene in a single forward pass. As shown in Fig. 2 , we first lift image observations into sparse point-aligned queries and decompose them into the static background and dynamic instances. Static queries remain in the shared world coordinate system, while dynamic queries align in object-centric canonical spaces. The core of PointForward V2 is scene-structured register interaction : static queries exchange information across views through Static Scene Registers, whereas dynamic queries interact independently within each instance through Dynamic Instance Registers. Unlike PointForward [ 8 ] , which independently aggregates cross-view evidence for each query through image-space reprojection, PointForward V2 directly enables information exchange among lifted point representations through compact registers.

PointForward V2的核心是场景结构的寄存器相互作用 :静态查询通过静态场景登记册交换观点间的信息,而动态查询则通过动态事件登记册在每一个实例内独立互动. 与 PointForward [8] 不同的是,PointForward V2 独立地通过图像空间重排来汇总每个查询的交叉视图证据,它直接通过紧凑的登记册在被解除的点表示之间进行信息交流.

blocks.en: 3.2 Scene-Structured Register Interaction

blocks.en: Direct global self-attention among all point queries incurs quadratic complexity, making it prohibitively expensive for large driving scenes. We therefore introduce compact learnable registers as communication bottlenecks between point queries. Specifically, we maintain shared register banks 𝐑 s ∈ ℝ R s × C \mathbf{R}^{s}\in\mathbb{R}^{R_{s}\times C} and 𝐑 d ∈ ℝ R d × C \mathbf{R}^{d}\in\mathbb{R}^{R_{d}\times C} , which are instantiated for each context view and dynamic instance, respectively. Rather than allowing all point queries to attend to one another directly, each interaction block follows a compress–communicate–broadcast procedure: registers first aggregate information from dense point queries, interaction is then performed in the compact register space, and the resulting context is finally propagated back to the point queries.

blocks.en: 4.3 Comparison with State-of-the-Art Methods
blocks.zh: 4.3 与最新方法的比较

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare PointForward V2 with both per-scene optimization and generalizable feedforward reconstruction methods. On Waymo, we include EmerNeRF [ 35 ] , 3DGS [ 16 ] , PVG [ 5 ] , and DeformableGS [ 38 ] as optimization-based baselines, together with recent feedforward approaches including LGM [ 28 ] , GS-LRM [ 40 ] , Depth Anything 3 [ 18 ] , AnySplat [ 14 ] , STORM [ 36 ] , DGGT [ 3 ] , and PointForward [ 8 ] . For DGGT, we follow PointForward’s evaluation setting, which disables its diffusion-based rendering refinement for qualitative visualization. This module is not specific to DGGT and can be applied to any method to refine rendered images. Removing it allows for a direct comparison of the raw Gaussian rendering quality across methods.

blocks.en: Waymo. As shown in Tab. 1 , PointForward V2 consistently outperforms previous methods on both full images and dynamic regions. Compared with PointForward, our method improves full-image PSNR from 28.48 to 29.88 and reduces D-RMSE from 3.35 to 2.89. The improvement is particularly pronounced in dynamic regions, where D-RMSE decreases from 6.07 to 3.99, demonstrating the benefit of point-aligned interaction. These gains indicate that information exchange among aligned point queries improves not only appearance reconstruction but also the geometric consistency of the recovered scene. Qualitative results in Fig. 3 further show more complete scene structures and more coherent dynamic-object reconstruction compared with STORM, DGGT, and PointForward.

blocks.en: Extrapolated View. Following PointForward [ 8 ] , we additionally examine rendering from extrapolated viewpoints beyond the observed camera trajectory. Fig. 5 highlights an important difference between the rendering designs of PointForward and PointForward V2. PointForward renders learned feature maps and subsequently converts them to RGB using convolutional refinement. Such spatial processing can plausibly fill regions that become newly visible under viewpoint changes. However, this completion is not explicitly constrained by the reconstructed 3D geometry and can therefore introduce incorrect structures. In contrast, PointForward V2 directly renders RGB-valued Gaussians. As shown in Fig. 5 , this avoids several erroneous completions produced by PointForward and preserves the underlying reconstructed content more faithfully.
blocks.zh: 外推法 观. 在“前进点”之后,我们进一步审查从观测到的摄影轨迹之外推导出的观点。 图5突出了PointForward和PointForward V2的渲染设计的重要区别. PointForward制作学习到的地物图,然后通过演化的精炼将其转换为RGB. 这种空间处理可以合理地填补在视角变化下新可见的区域。 然而,这一完成并没有受到重建的3D几何学的明确限制,因此可以引入不正确的结构. 相比之下,PointForward V2直接使RGB值的高斯人. 如图5所示,这避免了PointForward制作的若干错误的完成,并更忠实地保留了基础重建的内容.

blocks.en: Component Ablation. We first evaluate the contribution of the proposed interaction components in Tab. 4 . Removing all attention leads to a large performance drop, reducing PSNR from 29.88 to 21.42, confirming that interaction among point queries is critical for accurate reconstruction. Notably, retaining only the query–register cross-attention already recovers most of the performance, reaching 28.78 PSNR even without register self-attention. This shows that the compress–broadcast pathway itself enables effective indirect query interaction: the registers first aggregate information from multiple point queries and then redistribute the shared context back to them, forming a compact 𝐐 → 𝐑 → 𝐐 \mathbf{Q}\!\rightarrow\!\mathbf{R}\!\rightarrow\!\mathbf{Q} communication path. Register self-attention further improves the result to 29.88 PSNR by using the compressed representations to exchange information before being broadcast back to the dense point queries. This enables scene-level communication across different context views. Removing 4D RoPE causes only a small but consistent degradation, suggesting that aligned spatial and temporal cues provide complementary positional information for register-mediated interaction.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented PointForward V2, which advances feedforward driving reconstruction from point-aligned representation to point-aligned interaction. Building upon the sparse 3D queries, we introduce scene-structured registers that enable efficient inter-frame interaction for static scenes and intra-instance interaction for dynamic objects. Together with aligned 4D positional encoding, PointForward V2 supports scalable spatio-temporal reasoning without dense global attention. Experiments on Waymo, nuScenes, and Argoverse 2 demonstrate state-of-the-art reconstruction performance, while extensive ablations validate the effectiveness and scalability of the proposed interaction framework.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了 " 前进点V2 " ,它推动重建,从 " 点与点 " 代表到 " 点与点互动 " 。 在稀少的3D查询的基础上,我们采用了场景结构的登记册,从而能够对静态场景进行高效的帧间互动,对动态物体进行内置互动. 与对齐的4D位置编码一起,PointForward V2支持可伸缩的spatio-时空推理而无需密集的全球关注. 关于Waymo、nuScenes和Argoverse 2的实验显示了最先进的重建表现,而广泛的模拟则证实了拟议互动框架的有效性和可扩展性。

blocks.en: Limitations. PointForward V2 currently uses fixed query and register budgets across scenes and dynamic instances. In addition, our experiments focus on large-scale autonomous driving datasets; extending point-aligned interaction to more diverse dynamic environments and reconstruction settings remains an interesting direction.
blocks.zh: 限制。 PointForward V2目前使用固定查询,并登记跨场景和动态实例的预算. 此外,我们的实验侧重于大规模自主驱动数据集;将点对接的相互作用扩展到更多样化的动态环境和重建环境,仍然是一个有趣的方向。
